acceptanceCriteria: The 0.6.0 integration CEM is restored under `.corvint/changes/` from history, and `dogfood-seal` refuses to delete a tracked CEM whose base is not the current change.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-1/wave-2 pull requests (#74-#82). Every wave-1 PR's seal removed the tracked 6243-line 0.6.0 integration CEM that was never archived. The integration merge of #74-#82 accepted that deletion; recover it from commit 599fb5e.

completion.reason: Stale: every acceptance criterion is already met on origin/main (verified at a5aeee41). Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-06-stale-ticket-closure.md at 5a7045a537610b0afe2117428c8268c5d938c074 (PR beamfall/corvint#629), row V1-0137: commit 58ccd4cb,7dcd6216; AC1: .corvint/changes/82a113a8c48017685a2449ca3cf2a4bcb9847628.cem.json retains the integration CEM; script/dogfood-seal.sh:19 refuses unarchived-base-cem. Read-only independent verification (Codex batch C) plus mechanical check of cited commits, tests and paths; no suite rerun for this closure.

title: dogfood: `dogfood-seal` deleted the unarchived 0.6.0 integration CEM from `.corvint/change.cem.json`
